english: Yesterday I went to the market.
explanation_or_example: Ayer marks one completed past action. Correct tense: preterite.

spanish: De niño, yo ___  al parque cada tarde.
english: As a child, I used to go to the park every afternoon.
explanation_or_example: De niño and cada tarde describe a repeated past habit. Correct tense: imperfect.

spanish: Anoche Marta ___  la cena a las ocho.
english: Last night Marta prepared dinner at eight.
explanation_or_example: Anoche and a las ocho frame a completed event. Correct tense: preterite.

spanish: Mientras Marta ___  la cena, sonó el teléfono.
english: While Marta was preparing dinner, the phone rang.
explanation_or_example: Mientras sets background action in progress. Correct tense: imperfect.
El sábado points to one completed occasion. Correct tense: preterite.

spanish: Normalmente nosotros ___  temprano para la escuela.
english: Normally we used to leave early for school.
explanation_or_example: Normalmente signals repeated past routine. Correct tense: imperfect.

spanish: De repente, el tren ___  en la estación.
english: Suddenly, the train arrived at the station.
explanation_or_example: De repente introduces a completed interrupting action. Correct tense: preterite.

spanish: El tren ___  cuando empezó la lluvia.
english: The train was arriving when the rain started.
explanation_or_example: The arrival was in progress when another event happened. Correct tense: imperfect.
A bounded time period can use preterite. Correct tense: preterite.

spanish: Cuando la conocí, Ana ___  en Sevilla.
english: When I met her, Ana was living in Seville.
explanation_or_example: The living situation is background information. Correct tense: imperfect.

spanish: El profesor ___  la regla y luego dio ejemplos.
english: The teacher explained the rule and then gave examples.
explanation_or_example: A sequence of completed actions uses preterite. Correct tense: preterite.

spanish: El profesor ___  la regla cuando entró el director.
english: The teacher was explaining the rule when the principal came in.
explanation_or_example: The explanation was ongoing background action. Correct tense: imperfect.

explanation_or_example: A change of state at a moment uses preterite. Correct tense: preterite.

english: Every time he spoke in public, Luis would get nervous.
explanation_or_example: Cada vez que describes repeated past behavior. Correct tense: imperfect.

english: The meeting was already starting when I arrived.
explanation_or_example: The starting was in progress when another action happened. Correct tense: imperfect.
